findings.description: The regression check compares delta against max_drop without negating it, so it fires whenever hit@5 is unchanged or improved (delta below the positive threshold) instead of when it drops by more than max_drop.
findings.rationale: Trigger: run with --compare and --max-drop 0.03 where hit@5_delta is 0.0 or +0.05. Mechanism: 0.0 < 0.03 is true, so regression returns a message and main raises SystemExit. Impact: the CI gate fails on runs that did not regress, and any improvement under 0.03 is reported as a drop, while the intended threshold is never applied correctly.
